notes.title: Version 0.6.3
notes.content:
It’s been a while since the last update (understatement). I have a family issue at the moment (cancer). Therefore, I haven’t been really in the mood to work on this. I hope you understand that.

To be honest with you, I just want to drop this project. It is a freeware, and I don’t have any legal obligation to finish it. But it just doesn’t feel right for me to drop a project that is about 85% complete. Thus, I have started working on it starting in April.

At the same time, I’ve decided to cut off the third route with Heroine. The Aurora route will be the end.


⨭ Added

1. Story progression.

2. About Genkei’s story quest. In Cass route, it ended absurdly. His quest is supposed to be expanded in 3rd route with Heroine. However, with her route shelved now, that is no longer an option. Therefore, I’ve decided to alter the quest line to fit into Aurora’s route.
Meaning, the quest will now continue with Aurora instead of Heroine.
In short, quest updated.


💘 NSFW stuff

1. The second scene with Masha.


↹ Changed / Fixed

1. Apparently, I had a fair amount of spelling / grammar mistakes from the past update. They’ve been corrected.

2. With Aurora, there is now a real possibility that stamina will run out. Therefore, energy drink has been added to some automatic vendors and stores.

notes.title: An update
notes.content:
There has been an absence of any update since turning 2023. It is due to a family issue (cancer) that has stripped me of my desire to go on. It started (or rather was discovered) in December of 2022. Things have been rather chaotic ever since.

I've only recently started to work on the game again. Updates will come. Alas, I plan to cut it short however. There won't be the 3rd route. Aurora route will be it.

Thank you.

Now, I have a confession to make here. I always have endings planned out when I start writing stories and I make up the progress as I go.
When I was starting out, I fully expected Nick x Cass relationship to be full of sex and kinks.
However, as I wrote dialog for Nick and Cass, I started to realize that the two are not physically compatible, and that neither Nick nor Cass was deeply into the pleasures of flesh.
Therefore, I started to venture into a sexless couple route for them which was a total opposite of what I initially planned.

notes.title: Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
Welcome to 0.3x. This is where I am going to start expanding the game beyond Cold haven. Yes, you can now leave Cold haven as long as Nick has valid reasons (quests).

And I feel now is a good time to talk about routes. This game features four routes. I introduced three heroines who Nick can choose. Well, you don’t actually get to choose. Your interactions with the three women accumulate either plus or minus points.
When you reach the point of no return, depending on which points you have more, your choice will be made.

Now, there are three women but there are four routes.
The canon route is Cass. If you fail to get enough points for any women, the route will default to Cass route.

If you are looking for intercourse scenes, Cass route will feature the most because, unlike the other two women who are experienced and will not do anything outside of their comfort zone, she is blank. He actually gets to train her.

I will complete Cass route first which is derived into two further routes (Love Cass route and true neutral route), thus a total of four routes.

At patch 0.3.0, we are almost there for the first crossroad.


⨭ Added

1. A story quest “Chit chat” added. This is a small chat between Nick (you) and Kleon in Pink Spades. This is right after “A fool and another fool” encounter. 

2. Once you’ve had a date with Cass, Nick will have a short monologue when he approaches the sector exit elevator.

3. The first version of Freedom colony grid map has been implemented. It is what you will see once you leave Cold haven. 

4. The story is progressed just enough to allow Nick to be able to leave Cold haven.



💘 NSFW stuff

notes.title: Version 0.2.0

So, here they are, the three romance options for Nick, fully finalized.

4. Aurora is added. She is the second romance target for Nick and is the brain of the Kitty cats. Overall, she is upgraded Cass as both are ESPs. You cannot meet her yet but the character (sprite, bust images, etc) is implemented.

5. The heroine is introduced via a side quest “The fuck is happening?” Her real identity won’t be revealed for a while, but she is the third romance option for Nick. The heroine will mostly clash with Kleon and will sometimes be comic relief. She has the nicest body of all three (Cass and Aurora).

6. Some side quests now have timers. This is one of reasons for a new start as these will no longer advance with old saves.

7. Character rebalance:
⭷ Cass has been given more attack, making her pistol attack slightly more useful.
⭷ Waka drone (the first drone) has been slightly buffed.
⭷ Dakarai and Foluke have also been buffed.

Originally, that was fine because I didn’t intend to add detailed sexual scenes which swiftly changed when 0.1.1 was released.
